decision_correctness.method: 2 points per exact gold decision across 30 cases

evidence_identification.method: 25 multiplied by micro-averaged F1 over cited evidence IDs versus gold-required evidence IDs

reason_and_uncertainty.method: 15 multiplied by micro-averaged F1 over structured reason codes and CLARIFY clarification-needed categories

outcome_rules.CCS_ARCHITECTURE_ADDS_MEASURABLE_VALUE: Lane C materially outperforms Lane B on quality with no worse false-approval count, or ties on quality and has a material burden advantage.
outcome_rules.SIMPLE_LLM_WORKFLOW_PREFERRED_FOR_THIS_T: Lane B meets the symmetric condition against Lane C.
outcome_rules.DETERMINISTIC_AUTOMATION_SUFFICIENT_FOR_: Lane A practically ties the best AI lane on quality and has a material burden advantage.
outcome_rules.MIXED_TRADEOFF: Quality, safety, and burden advantages point in different directions.
outcome_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: A critical control is violated or the comparison cannot be scored under the frozen protocol.
